system.description:
Queen of the Summer Court. Warmth that can become burning in an instant.

  • Dark Gift (1st): Warm light emanates from you when you cast — no shadows form within 10ft. Once per day, choose the worst possible outcome when a creature within 30ft fails a save rather than rolling.
  • Patron's Mark (4th): Passive: fey creatures, animals, and plants react positively to your presence — animals never attack you first, and fey creatures treat you as a known and respected figure until you give them reason not to.
  • Patron Feature (8th): Once per day, impose Summer's Blessing or Summer's Wrath on one creature within 60ft.
  • Blessing: the target regains HP up to its maximum (no save).
  • Wrath: Str and Dex reduced by 2 for 1 minute (target makes the relevant save against your Class Save DC).

Allegiance: Chaotic Good, the patron's alignment. Lore: Tiandra (Titania) in the World of Arneyan wiki.
